attributes.board_name: Nebraska State Board of Nursing (Department of Health and Human Services, Licensure Unit)

rules.alternatives: No general CE hours for APRN-NP renewal: current national certification is required, plus (if licensed more than 5 years) at least 2,080 hours of NP practice in the 5 years before renewal. A current Nebraska or multistate RN license is also required.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of the opiate CE by the Nursing Licensure Unit; selected licensees submit certificates totaling 3 hours.

topics.who: NPs and CNMs who prescribe controlled substances; renewals 2020 through 2028; 0.5 h must cover the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP)

rules.notes: APRN licenses expire Oct 31 of each even-numbered year. The only CE hours are 3 h opiate prescribing (renewals 2020-2028); DHHS offers free qualifying programs.
